query: SELECT c.name AS country, COUNT(*) AS airport_count FROM airports a JOIN countries c ON a.country = c.name GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY airport_count DESC, country LIMIT 10;
SELECT al.name AS airline, COUNT(*) AS route_count FROM routes r JOIN airlines al ON r.airline_id = al.airline_id WHERE al.active = 'Y' GROUP BY al.name ORDER BY route_count DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT a.city, a.name AS airport_name, COUNT(*) AS departing_routes FROM routes r JOIN airports a ON r.source_airport_id = a.airport_id GROUP BY a.city, a.name ORDER BY departing_routes DESC, a.city, a.name LIMIT 8;
SELECT r.equipment, COUNT(*) AS frequency FROM routes r WHERE r.stops = 0 GROUP BY r.equipment ORDER BY frequency DESC LIMIT 6;
SELECT a.country, AVG(a.altitude) AS avg_altitude_ft FROM airports a GROUP BY a.country HAVING AVG(a.altitude) > 1000 ORDER BY avg_altitude_ft DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT a1.country FROM airports a1 JOIN routes r ON a1.airport_id = r.source_airport_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id WHERE a1.country <> a2.country ORDER BY a1.country;

SELECT al.name AS airline, a.city AS base_city FROM airlines al JOIN routes r ON al.airline_id = r.airline_id JOIN airports a ON r.source_airport_id = a.airport_id WHERE al.country = a.country GROUP BY al.name, a.city ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT a.name AS airport, COUNT(DISTINCT r.airline_id) AS unique_airlines FROM routes r JOIN airports a ON r.source_airport_id = a.airport_id GROUP BY a.name ORDER BY unique_airlines DESC, airport LIMIT 7;

SELECT p.icao AS plane_code, COUNT(*) AS route_usage FROM routes r, LATERAL (SELECT TRIM(unnest(string_split(r.equipment, ' '))) AS eq) equipment_list JOIN planes p ON equipment_list.eq = p.iata GROUP BY p.icao HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY route_usage DESC;
SELECT a.timezone, COUNT(*) AS airport_count FROM airports a WHERE a.timezone IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.timezone ORDER BY airport_count DESC;

SELECT c.name AS country, COUNT(DISTINCT a.airport_id) AS intl_airport_count FROM airports a JOIN routes r ON a.airport_id = r.source_airport_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id JOIN countries c ON a.country = c.name WHERE a.country <> a2.country GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY intl_airport_count DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT al.name AS airline, COUNT(DISTINCT r.destination_airport_id) AS destinations_served FROM routes r JOIN airlines al ON r.airline_id = al.airline_id WHERE al.icao IS NOT NULL GROUP BY al.name ORDER BY destinations_served DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT a.city, COUNT(DISTINCT r.airline_id) AS airlines_operating FROM routes r JOIN airports a ON r.source_airport_id = a.airport_id GROUP BY a.city ORDER BY airlines_operating DESC, a.city LIMIT 8

SELECT p.name AS plane_model, COUNT(*) AS direct_route_count FROM routes r, LATERAL (SELECT TRIM(unnest(string_split(r.equipment, ' '))) AS eq) equipment_list JOIN planes p ON equipment_list.eq = p.iata WHERE r.stops = 0 GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY direct_route_count DESC LIMIT 6
SELECT a.country, MAX(a.altitude) AS highest_airport_ft FROM airports a GROUP BY a.country HAVING MAX(a.altitude) > 5000 ORDER BY highest_airport_ft DESC
SELECT DISTINCT c.name AS country FROM countries c JOIN airports a ON c.name = a.country JOIN routes r ON a.airport_id = r.source_airport_id WHERE r.codeshare = 'Y' ORDER BY c.name

SELECT al.name AS airline, COUNT(*) AS domestic_flights FROM routes r JOIN airlines al ON r.airline_id = al.airline_id JOIN airports a1 ON r.source_airport_id = a1.airport_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id WHERE a1.country = a2.country AND al.active = 'Y' GROUP BY al.name ORDER BY domestic_flights DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT a.name AS airport, COUNT(*) AS total_routes FROM routes r JOIN airports a ON r.source_airport_id = a.airport_id OR r.destination_airport_id = a.airport_id GROUP BY a.name ORDER BY total_routes DESC, airport LIMIT 7

SELECT p.icao AS plane_type, COUNT(DISTINCT r.airline_id) AS airlines_using FROM routes r, LATERAL (SELECT TRIM(unnest(string_split(r.equipment, ' '))) AS eq) equipment_list JOIN planes p ON equipment_list.eq = p.iata GROUP BY p.icao HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.airline_id) > 1 ORDER BY airlines_using DESC
SELECT a.tz_db AS timezone_region, AVG(a.latitude) AS avg_latitude FROM airports a WHERE a.tz_db IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.tz_db ORDER BY avg_latitude DESC

SELECT al.name AS airline, a.country AS base_country, COUNT(*) AS routes_from_home FROM routes r JOIN airlines al ON r.airline_id = al.airline_id JOIN airports a ON r.source_airport_id = a.airport_id WHERE al.country = a.country GROUP BY al.name, a.country ORDER BY routes_from_home DESC LIMIT 8;
SELECT a.country, COUNT(DISTINCT a.city) AS cities_with_airports FROM airports a GROUP BY a.country HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.city) > 5 ORDER BY cities_with_airports DESC, a.country;

SELECT r.source_airport, r.destination_airport, COUNT(*) AS frequency FROM routes r GROUP BY r.source_airport, r.destination_airport HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY frequency DESC, r.source_airport, r.destination_airport LIMIT 10;

SELECT a.city, a.country, COUNT(DISTINCT r.destination_airport_id) AS unique_destinations FROM routes r JOIN airports a ON r.source_airport_id = a.airport_id GROUP BY a.city, a.country ORDER BY unique_destinations DESC LIMIT 6;

SELECT al.name AS airline, COUNT(DISTINCT a2.country) AS countries_served FROM routes r JOIN airlines al ON r.airline_id = al.airline_id JOIN airports a1 ON r.source_airport_id = a1.airport_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id WHERE al.active = 'Y' GROUP BY al.name ORDER BY countries_served DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT a.country, ROUND(AVG(a.latitude), 2) AS avg_latitude, ROUND(AVG(a.longitude), 2) AS avg_longitude FROM airports a GROUP BY a.country ORDER BY a.country;
SELECT al.country, COUNT(DISTINCT al.airline_id) AS active_airlines FROM airlines al WHERE al.active = 'Y' GROUP BY al.country ORDER BY active_airlines DESC, al.country LIMIT 10;
SELECT a.name AS airport, a.altitude, a.city, a.country FROM airports a WHERE a.altitude < 0 ORDER BY a.altitude ASC LIMIT 5;
SELECT a.timezone, COUNT(DISTINCT a.country) AS countries_in_timezone FROM airports a WHERE a.timezone IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.timezone ORDER BY countries_in_timezone DESC, a.timezone;
SELECT r.airline, COUNT(*) AS total_routes, SUM(r.stops) AS total_stops FROM routes r GROUP BY r.airline HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 ORDER BY total_stops DESC, total_routes DESC LIMIT 8;

SELECT a.country, COUNT(*) AS total_airports, SUM(CASE WHEN a.altitude > 5000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_altitude_count FROM airports a GROUP BY a.country HAVING total_airports > 10 ORDER BY high_altitude_count DESC, total_airports DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT al.name AS airline, COUNT(DISTINCT r.equipment) AS distinct_plane_types FROM routes r JOIN airlines al ON r.airline_id = al.airline_id WHERE al.active = 'Y' GROUP BY al.name ORDER BY distinct_plane_types DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT a.city, COUNT(DISTINCT r.destination_airport_id) AS international_destinations FROM routes r JOIN airports a ON r.source_airport_id = a.airport_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id WHERE a.country <> a2.country GROUP BY a.city ORDER BY international_destinations DESC, a.city LIMIT 10

SELECT r.source_airport, r.destination_airport, AVG(r.stops) AS avg_stops FROM routes r GROUP BY r.source_airport, r.destination_airport HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY avg_stops DESC, r.source_airport, r.destination_airport LIMIT 8

SELECT c.name AS country, COUNT(DISTINCT al.airline_id) AS airlines_based FROM countries c JOIN airlines al ON c.name = al.country WHERE al.active = 'Y' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY airlines_based DESC, c.name LIMIT 7

SELECT a.country, COUNT(*) AS airports_count, MIN(a.altitude) AS lowest_altitude, MAX(a.altitude) AS highest_altitude FROM airports a GROUP BY a.country HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY (highest_altitude - lowest_altitude) DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT al.name AS airline, COUNT(*) AS total_routes, COUNT(DISTINCT a2.country) AS countries_served FROM routes r JOIN airlines al ON r.airline_id = al.airline_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id WHERE al.iata IS NOT NULL GROUP BY al.name ORDER BY countries_served DESC, total_routes DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT r.airline, COUNT(*) AS direct_flights FROM routes r WHERE r.stops = 0 AND r.codeshare IS NULL GROUP BY r.airline ORDER BY direct_flights DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT a1.country AS source_country, a2.country AS dest_country, COUNT(*) AS route_count FROM routes r JOIN airports a1 ON r.source_airport_id = a1.airport_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id WHERE a1.country <> a2.country GROUP BY a1.country, a2.country ORDER BY route_count DESC, a1.country, a2.country LIMIT 10
SELECT a.country, COUNT(*) AS airport_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a.city) AS city_count FROM airports a GROUP BY a.country ORDER BY city_count DESC, airport_count DESC LIMIT 8;

SELECT al.name AS airline, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 THEN r.destination_airport_id END) AS direct_destinations FROM routes r JOIN airlines al ON r.airline_id = al.airline_id WHERE al.active = 'Y' GROUP BY al.name ORDER BY direct_destinations DESC LIMIT 6;
SELECT a.city, a.country, COUNT(*) AS airport_count FROM airports a GROUP BY a.city, a.country HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY airport_count DESC, a.city, a.country;

SELECT r.source_airport, COUNT(DISTINCT r.airline_id) AS airlines_count FROM routes r GROUP BY r.source_airport HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.airline_id) > 3 ORDER BY airlines_count DESC, r.source_airport LIMIT 10;

SELECT al.country, AVG(route_counts.total_routes) AS avg_routes_per_airline FROM airlines al JOIN (SELECT airline_id, COUNT(*) AS total_routes FROM routes GROUP BY airline_id) route_counts ON al.airline_id = route_counts.airline_id WHERE al.active = 'Y' GROUP BY al.country ORDER BY avg_routes_per_airline DESC LIMIT 8;

SELECT a.country, COUNT(*) AS total_airports, SUM(CASE WHEN a.altitude BETWEEN 1000 AND 5000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mid_altitude_count FROM airports a GROUP BY a.country HAVING total_airports > 5 ORDER BY mid_altitude_count DESC LIMIT 6;

SELECT a.tz_db, COUNT(DISTINCT a.country) AS country_count, COUNT(*) AS airport_count FROM airports a WHERE a.tz_db IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.tz_db ORDER BY country_count DESC, airport_count DESC LIMIT 8;
SELECT r.airline, COUNT(*) AS total_routes, ROUND(AVG(r.stops), 2) AS avg_stops FROM routes r GROUP BY r.airline HAVING COUNT(*) > 20 ORDER BY avg_stops ASC, total_routes DESC LIMIT 7;

SELECT a1.country, a2.country, COUNT(*) AS connection_count FROM routes r JOIN airports a1 ON r.source_airport_id = a1.airport_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id WHERE a1.country <> a2.country AND r.stops > 0 GROUP BY a1.country, a2.country ORDER BY connection_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT p.icao, COUNT(DISTINCT r.airline_id) AS airline_count, COUNT(*) AS route_count FROM routes r, LATERAL (SELECT TRIM(unnest(string_split(r.equipment, ' '))) AS eq) equipment_list JOIN planes p ON equipment_list.eq = p.iata GROUP BY p.icao HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.airline_id) > 2 ORDER BY route_count DESC LIMIT 6;

SELECT a.country, COUNT(DISTINCT r.airline_id) AS international_airlines FROM routes r JOIN airports a ON r.source_airport_id = a.airport_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id WHERE a.country <> a2.country GROUP BY a.country ORDER BY international_airlines DESC LIMIT 8;

SELECT al.name AS airline, COUNT(*) AS codeshare_routes FROM routes r JOIN airlines al ON r.airline_id = al.airline_id WHERE r.codeshare = 'Y' AND al.active = 'Y' GROUP BY al.name ORDER BY codeshare_routes DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT a.city, COUNT(DISTINCT r.destination_airport_id) AS domestic_destinations FROM routes r JOIN airports a ON r.source_airport_id = a.airport_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id WHERE a.country = a2.country GROUP BY a.city ORDER BY domestic_destinations DESC, a.city LIMIT 7;

SELECT r.source_airport, r.destination_airport, MIN(r.stops) AS min_stops, MAX(r.stops) AS max_stops FROM routes r GROUP BY r.source_airport, r.destination_airport HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY max_stops DESC, min_stops DESC LIMIT 6;
SELECT al.country, COUNT(*) AS active_airports FROM airlines al JOIN airports a ON al.country = a.country WHERE al.active = 'Y' GROUP BY al.country ORDER BY active_airports DESC LIMIT 8;
SELECT a.country, COUNT(*) AS coastal_airports FROM airports a WHERE a.altitude < 100 GROUP BY a.country ORDER BY coastal_airports DESC, a.country LIMIT 6;
SELECT r.airline, COUNT(DISTINCT r.source_airport_id) AS base_airports FROM routes r GROUP BY r.airline HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.source_airport_id) > 1 ORDER BY base_airports DESC, r.airline LIMIT 5;
SELECT a.timezone, COUNT(DISTINCT a.city) AS cities_covered FROM airports a WHERE a.timezone IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.timezone ORDER BY cities_covered DESC, a.timezone LIMIT 7;

SELECT al.name AS airline, COUNT(*) AS multi_stop_routes FROM routes r JOIN airlines al ON r.airline_id = al.airline_id WHERE r.stops > 1 AND al.active = 'Y' GROUP BY al.name ORDER BY multi_stop_routes DESC LIMIT 4;
SELECT a.latitude, a.longitude, a.name AS airport, a.country FROM airports a WHERE a.altitude > 8000 ORDER BY a.altitude DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT a.country, COUNT(*) AS airport_count, COUNT(DISTINCT al.airline_id) AS active_airlines FROM airports a LEFT JOIN airlines al ON a.country = al.country AND al.active = 'Y' GROUP BY a.country HAVING airport_count > 5 ORDER BY active_airlines DESC, airport_count DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT al.name AS airline, COUNT(*) AS total_routes, COUNT(DISTINCT r.source_airport_id) AS departure_airports FROM routes r JOIN airlines al ON r.airline_id = al.airline_id WHERE al.icao IS NOT NULL GROUP BY al.name ORDER BY departure_airports DESC, total_routes DESC LIMIT 6
SELECT a.city, COUNT(*) AS airports_in_city, AVG(a.altitude) AS avg_altitude FROM airports a GROUP BY a.city HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY avg_altitude DESC, a.city LIMIT 7

SELECT r.source_airport, COUNT(DISTINCT r.destination_airport) AS unique_destinations, AVG(r.stops) AS avg_stops FROM routes r GROUP BY r.source_airport HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.destination_airport) > 10 ORDER BY unique_destinations DESC, avg_stops ASC LIMIT 5

SELECT al.country, COUNT(*) AS airline_count, SUM(CASE WHEN al.active = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count FROM airlines al GROUP BY al.country HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY active_count DESC, airline_count DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT a.country, ROUND(AVG(a.latitude), 2) AS avg_lat, ROUND(AVG(a.longitude), 2) AS avg_lon, COUNT(*) AS airport_count FROM airports a GROUP BY a.country HAVING COUNT(*) > 2 ORDER BY airport_count DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT r.airline, COUNT(*) AS total_routes, COUNT(DISTINCT r.equipment) AS equipment_types FROM routes r GROUP BY r.airline HAVING COUNT(*) > 15 ORDER BY equipment_types DESC, total_routes DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT al.name AS airline, COUNT(*) AS international_routes FROM routes r JOIN airlines al ON r.airline_id = al.airline_id JOIN airports a1 ON r.source_airport_id = a1.airport_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id WHERE a1.country <> a2.country AND al.active = 'Y' GROUP BY al.name ORDER BY international_routes DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT a.country, COUNT(*) AS total_airports, COUNT(DISTINCT a.timezone) AS timezones_covered FROM airports a WHERE a.timezone IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.country HAVING COUNT(*) > 4 ORDER BY timezones_covered DESC, total_airports DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT al.name AS airline, COUNT(*) AS total_routes, COUNT(DISTINCT r.equipment) AS equipment_variety FROM routes r JOIN airlines al ON r.airline_id = al.airline_id WHERE al.callsign IS NOT NULL GROUP BY al.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 ORDER BY equipment_variety DESC, total_routes DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT a.country, COUNT(DISTINCT a.city) AS cities_served, COUNT(DISTINCT r.airline_id) AS airlines_operating FROM airports a JOIN routes r ON a.airport_id = r.source_airport_id GROUP BY a.country HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.city) > 3 ORDER BY airlines_operating DESC, cities_served DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT r.source_airport, r.destination_airport, COUNT(*) AS frequency, AVG(r.stops) AS avg_stops FROM routes r GROUP BY r.source_airport, r.destination_airport HAVING COUNT(*) > 2 AND AVG(r.stops) > 0 ORDER BY frequency DESC, avg_stops DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT a.city, COUNT(DISTINCT r.airline_id) AS airlines_count, COUNT(DISTINCT r.destination_airport_id) AS destinations_count FROM routes r JOIN airports a ON r.source_airport_id = a.airport_id GROUP BY a.city HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.airline_id) > 2 ORDER BY destinations_count DESC, airlines_count DESC LIMIT 7

SELECT al.country, COUNT(DISTINCT al.airline_id) AS total_airlines, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN al.active = 'Y' THEN al.airline_id END) AS active_airlines FROM airlines al GROUP BY al.country HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT al.airline_id) > 2 ORDER BY active_airlines DESC, total_airlines DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT a.timezone, COUNT(*) AS airport_count, ROUND(AVG(a.longitude), 2) AS avg_longitude FROM airports a WHERE a.timezone IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.timezone HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY airport_count DESC, avg_longitude DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT r.airline, COUNT(*) AS routes_count, COUNT(DISTINCT r.source_airport_id) AS source_airports FROM routes r WHERE r.stops = 0 GROUP BY r.airline HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY source_airports DESC, routes_count DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT a.country, COUNT(*) AS airport_count, ROUND(AVG(a.altitude), 2) AS avg_altitude, MAX(a.altitude) - MIN(a.altitude) AS altitude_range FROM airports a GROUP BY a.country HAVING COUNT(*) > 4 ORDER BY altitude_range DESC, avg_altitude DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT al.name AS airline, COUNT(DISTINCT a2.country) AS countries_served, COUNT(*) AS total_routes FROM routes r JOIN airlines al ON r.airline_id = al.airline_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id WHERE al.iata IS NOT NULL GROUP BY al.name ORDER BY countries_served DESC, total_routes DESC LIMIT 4

SELECT a.city, a.country, COUNT(DISTINCT r.destination_airport_id) AS international_destinations, COUNT(DISTINCT r.airline_id) AS international_airlines FROM routes r JOIN airports a ON r.source_airport_id = a.airport_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id WHERE a.country <> a2.country GROUP BY a.city, a.country ORDER BY international_destinations DESC, international_airlines DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT a.country, COUNT(*) AS airports_with_icao FROM airports a WHERE a.icao IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.country ORDER BY airports_with_icao DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT al.name AS airline, a.city AS hub_city, COUNT(*) AS routes_from_hub FROM routes r JOIN airlines al ON r.airline_id = al.airline_id JOIN airports a ON r.source_airport_id = a.airport_id WHERE al.country = a.country GROUP BY al.name, a.city HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 ORDER BY routes_from_hub DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT r.source_airport, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 THEN r.destination_airport END) AS direct_destinations FROM routes r GROUP BY r.source_airport HAVING direct_destinations > 5 ORDER BY direct_destinations DESC LIMIT 7

SELECT a.country, COUNT(*) AS total_airports, COUNT(DISTINCT a.type) AS airport_types FROM airports a GROUP BY a.country HAVING total_airports > 3 ORDER BY airport_types DESC, total_airports DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT al.name AS airline, COUNT(*) AS routes_with_codeshare FROM routes r JOIN airlines al ON r.airline_id = al.airline_id WHERE r.codeshare = 'Y' GROUP BY al.name ORDER BY routes_with_codeshare DESC LIMIT 4
SELECT a.city, COUNT(DISTINCT a.country) AS countries_per_city FROM airports a GROUP BY a.city HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.country) > 1 ORDER BY countries_per_city DESC, a.city LIMIT 5
SELECT r.airline, MIN(r.stops) AS min_stops, MAX(r.stops) AS max_stops, AVG(r.stops) AS avg_stops FROM routes r GROUP BY r.airline HAVING COUNT(*) > 8 ORDER BY max_stops DESC, avg_stops DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT al.country, COUNT(DISTINCT al.airline_id) AS total_airlines, COUNT(DISTINCT r.source_airport_id) AS airports_served FROM airlines al JOIN routes r ON al.airline_id = r.airline_id GROUP BY al.country HAVING total_airlines > 2 ORDER BY airports_served DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT a.country, ROUND(AVG(a.latitude), 2) AS avg_latitude, ROUND(AVG(a.longitude), 2) AS avg_longitude, COUNT(*) AS airport_count FROM airports a GROUP BY a.country HAVING airport_count BETWEEN 5 AND 20 ORDER BY airport_count DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT al.name AS airline, COUNT(DISTINCT r.equipment) AS plane_types_used, COUNT(*) AS total_routes FROM routes r JOIN airlines al ON r.airline_id = al.airline_id WHERE al.active = 'Y' GROUP BY al.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 15 ORDER BY plane_types_used DESC, total_routes DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT a.country, COUNT(*) AS airport_count, SUM(CASE WHEN a.altitude > 2000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_altitude_count FROM airports a GROUP BY a.country HAVING high_altitude_count > 0 ORDER BY high_altitude_count DESC, airport_count DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT r.source_airport, COUNT(DISTINCT r.destination_airport_id) AS destinations, COUNT(DISTINCT r.airline_id) AS airlines FROM routes r GROUP BY r.source_airport HAVING destinations > 8 AND airlines > 3 ORDER BY destinations DESC, airlines DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT al.country, COUNT(DISTINCT al.airline_id) AS airlines, AVG(route_count) AS avg_routes FROM airlines al JOIN (SELECT airline_id, COUNT(*) AS route_count FROM routes GROUP BY airline_id) rc ON al.airline_id = rc.airline_id WHERE al.active = 'Y' GROUP BY al.country HAVING airlines > 2 ORDER BY avg_routes DESC LIMIT 7

SELECT a.city, COUNT(*) AS airport_count, COUNT(DISTINCT r.airline_id) AS airlines_serving FROM airports a LEFT JOIN routes r ON a.airport_id = r.source_airport_id GROUP BY a.city HAVING airport_count > 1 ORDER BY airlines_serving DESC, airport_count DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT r.airline, COUNT(*) AS total_routes, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 THEN r.destination_airport_id END) AS direct_destinations FROM routes r GROUP BY r.airline HAVING total_routes > 10 ORDER BY direct_destinations DESC, total_routes DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT a.country, COUNT(DISTINCT a.timezone) AS timezones, MAX(a.altitude) - MIN(a.altitude) AS altitude_range FROM airports a WHERE a.timezone IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.country HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY altitude_range DESC, timezones DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT al.name AS airline, COUNT(DISTINCT a2.country) AS countries_served, COUNT(*) AS international_routes FROM routes r JOIN airlines al ON r.airline_id = al.airline_id JOIN airports a1 ON r.source_airport_id = a1.airport_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id WHERE a1.country <> a2.country GROUP BY al.name ORDER BY countries_served DESC, international_routes DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT r.source_airport, r.destination_airport, COUNT(*) AS frequency, MIN(r.stops) AS best_route, MAX(r.stops) AS worst_route FROM routes r GROUP BY r.source_airport, r.destination_airport HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY frequency DESC, best_route ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT a.country, COUNT(*) AS total_airports, COUNT(DISTINCT r.airline_id) AS airlines_operating FROM airports a LEFT JOIN routes r ON a.airport_id = r.source_airport_id GROUP BY a.country HAVING total_airports > 3 ORDER BY airlines_operating DESC, total_airports DESC LIMIT 8;

SELECT al.name AS airline, COUNT(*) AS routes_count, COUNT(DISTINCT r.source_airport_id) AS departure_bases FROM routes r JOIN airlines al ON r.airline_id = al.airline_id WHERE al.active = 'Y' GROUP BY al.name HAVING routes_count > 5 ORDER BY departure_bases DESC, routes_count DESC LIMIT 6;

SELECT a.city, COUNT(*) AS airports_in_city, COUNT(DISTINCT r.destination_airport_id) AS destinations_served FROM airports a JOIN routes r ON a.airport_id = r.source_airport_id GROUP BY a.city HAVING airports_in_city > 1 ORDER BY destinations_served DESC, airports_in_city DESC LIMIT 7;

SELECT r.source_airport, COUNT(DISTINCT r.destination_airport_id) AS unique_destinations, COUNT(DISTINCT r.airline_id) AS airlines_count FROM routes r GROUP BY r.source_airport HAVING unique_destinations > 5 ORDER BY unique_destinations DESC, airlines_count DESC LIMIT 6;

SELECT al.country, COUNT(DISTINCT al.airline_id) AS total_airlines, AVG(route_counts.routes) AS avg_routes_per_airline FROM airlines al JOIN (SELECT airline_id, COUNT(*) AS routes FROM routes GROUP BY airline_id) route_counts ON al.airline_id = route_counts.airline_id GROUP BY al.country HAVING total_airlines > 2 ORDER BY avg_routes_per_airline DESC LIMIT 8;

SELECT a.country, COUNT(*) AS airport_count, SUM(CASE WHEN a.altitude BETWEEN 0 AND 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_altitude_count FROM airports a GROUP BY a.country HAVING airport_count > 4 ORDER BY low_altitude_count DESC, airport_count DESC LIMIT 6;

SELECT r.airline, COUNT(*) AS total_routes, COUNT(DISTINCT r.equipment) AS equipment_variety FROM routes r GROUP BY r.airline HAVING total_routes > 10 AND equipment_variety > 1 ORDER BY equipment_variety DESC, total_routes DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT al.name AS airline, COUNT(DISTINCT r.destination_airport_id) AS destinations, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops > 0 THEN r.equipment END) AS indirect_equipment, ROUND(AVG(a2.altitude), 1) AS avg_dest_alt FROM routes r JOIN airlines al ON r.airline_id = al.airline_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id WHERE al.active = 'Y' GROUP BY al.name HAVING destinations > 8 ORDER BY indirect_equipment DESC, avg_dest_alt DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT r.source_airport, COUNT(DISTINCT r.destination_airport_id) AS destinations, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.codeshare = 'Y' THEN r.airline_id END) AS codeshare_airlines, MAX(a.latitude) AS max_lat FROM routes r JOIN airports a ON r.source_airport_id = a.airport_id GROUP BY r.source_airport HAVING destinations > 4 ORDER BY codeshare_airlines DESC, max_lat DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT a.country, COUNT(*) AS airports, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.altitude > 2000 THEN 1 END) AS high_altitude, COUNT(DISTINCT r.equipment) AS unique_aircraft FROM airports a LEFT JOIN routes r ON a.airport_id = r.source_airport_id GROUP BY a.country HAVING airports > 3 ORDER BY high_altitude DESC, unique_aircraft DESC LIMIT 7

SELECT r.airline, COUNT(*) AS routes, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 THEN r.destination_airport_id END) AS direct_dests, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.codeshare = 'Y' THEN r.source_airport_id END) AS codeshare_sources FROM routes r GROUP BY r.airline HAVING routes > 12 ORDER BY direct_dests DESC, codeshare_sources DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT a.country, COUNT(DISTINCT a.airport_id) AS airports, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 AND r.codeshare = 'N' THEN r.destination_airport_id END) AS direct_non_codeshare_dests FROM airports a LEFT JOIN routes r ON a.airport_id = r.source_airport_id GROUP BY a.country HAVING airports > 2 ORDER BY direct_non_codeshare_dests DESC, airports DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT al.name AS airline, COUNT(*) AS routes, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a1.country = a2.country THEN r.destination_airport_id END) AS domestic_destinations, ROUND(AVG(r.stops), 2) AS avg_stops FROM routes r JOIN airlines al ON r.airline_id = al.airline_id JOIN airports a1 ON r.source_airport_id = a1.airport_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id WHERE al.active = 'Y' GROUP BY al.name HAVING routes > 10 ORDER BY domestic_destinations DESC, avg_stops ASC LIMIT 5

SELECT r.equipment, COUNT(*) AS routes, COUNT(DISTINCT r.airline_id) AS airlines, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a2.altitude < 0 THEN r.destination_airport_id END) AS below_sea_level_dests FROM routes r JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id GROUP BY r.equipment HAVING routes > 8 ORDER BY below_sea_level_dests DESC, airlines DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT a.city, a.country, COUNT(DISTINCT r.airline_id) AS airlines, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 1 THEN r.destination_airport_id END) AS one_stop_destinations FROM airports a JOIN routes r ON a.airport_id = r.source_airport_id GROUP BY a.city, a.country HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.airline_id) > 3 ORDER BY one_stop_destinations DESC, airlines DESC LIMIT 7

SELECT al.country, COUNT(DISTINCT al.airline_id) AS airlines, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN al.active = 'N' THEN al.airline_id END) AS inactive_airlines, COUNT(DISTINCT r.equipment) AS aircraft_types FROM airlines al LEFT JOIN routes r ON al.airline_id = r.airline_id GROUP BY al.country HAVING airlines > 1 ORDER BY inactive_airlines DESC, aircraft_types DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT a.timezone, COUNT(*) AS airports, COUNT(DISTINCT r.destination_airport_id) AS destinations, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops > 1 THEN r.airline_id END) AS multi_stop_airlines FROM airports a JOIN routes r ON a.airport_id = r.source_airport_id WHERE a.timezone IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.timezone HAVING airports > 3 ORDER BY multi_stop_airlines DESC, destinations DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT al.name AS airline, COUNT(DISTINCT r.source_airport_id) AS hubs, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a2.country = 'United States' THEN r.destination_airport_id END) AS us_destinations, ROUND(AVG(a2.longitude), 2) AS avg_dest_lon FROM routes r JOIN airlines al ON r.airline_id = al.airline_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id WHERE al.active = 'Y' GROUP BY al.name HAVING hubs > 1 ORDER BY us_destinations DESC, avg_dest_lon DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT r.source_airport, r.destination_airport, COUNT(*) AS frequency, COUNT(DISTINCT r.airline_id) AS airlines, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.codeshare = 'Y' AND r.stops = 0 THEN 1 END) AS direct_codeshares FROM routes r GROUP BY r.source_airport, r.destination_airport HAVING frequency > 2 ORDER BY direct_codeshares DESC, airlines DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT a.country, COUNT(*) AS airports, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.type = 'medium_airport' THEN 1 END) AS medium_airports, ROUND(AVG(a.altitude), 1) AS avg_altitude FROM airports a GROUP BY a.country HAVING airports > 4 ORDER BY medium_airports DESC, avg_altitude DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT al.name AS airline, COUNT(*) AS routes, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 AND a2.latitude > 60 THEN r.destination_airport_id END) AS arctic_destinations FROM routes r JOIN airlines al ON r.airline_id = al.airline_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id WHERE al.active = 'Y' GROUP BY al.name HAVING routes > 10 ORDER BY arctic_destinations DESC, routes DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT a.country, COUNT(*) AS airports, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.type = 'balloonport' THEN 1 END) AS balloonports, ROUND(AVG(a.longitude), 2) AS avg_longitude FROM airports a GROUP BY a.country HAVING airports > 2 ORDER BY balloonports DESC, avg_longitude DESC LIMIT 7

SELECT r.equipment, COUNT(*) AS routes, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a1.altitude < 0 THEN r.source_airport_id END) AS below_sea_level_sources, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a2.altitude > 2000 THEN r.destination_airport_id END) AS high_altitude_dests FROM routes r JOIN airports a1 ON r.source_airport_id = a1.airport_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id GROUP BY r.equipment HAVING routes > 8 ORDER BY below_sea_level_sources DESC, high_altitude_dests DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT al.country, COUNT(DISTINCT al.airline_id) AS airlines, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN al.icao LIKE 'A%' THEN al.airline_id END) AS a_code_airlines, SUM(CASE WHEN r.stops = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS one_stop_routes FROM airlines al JOIN routes r ON al.airline_id = r.airline_id GROUP BY al.country HAVING airlines > 1 ORDER BY a_code_airlines DESC, one_stop_routes DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT a.city, COUNT(DISTINCT r.destination_airport_id) AS destinations, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 2 THEN r.destination_airport_id END) AS two_stop_destinations, ROUND(AVG(a.latitude), 2) AS avg_city_lat FROM airports a JOIN routes r ON a.airport_id = r.source_airport_id GROUP BY a.city HAVING destinations > 5 ORDER BY two_stop_destinations DESC, avg_city_lat DESC LIMIT 7

SELECT al.name AS airline, COUNT(DISTINCT r.equipment) AS aircraft_types, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 AND a2.altitude < 0 THEN r.destination_airport_id END) AS below_sea_level_direct_dests, ROUND(AVG(r.stops), 2) AS avg_stops FROM routes r JOIN airlines al ON r.airline_id = al.airline_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id WHERE al.active = 'Y' GROUP BY al.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 15 ORDER BY below_sea_level_direct_dests DESC, aircraft_types DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT r.source_airport, r.destination_airport, COUNT(*) AS frequency, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 THEN r.airline_id END) AS direct_airlines, COUNT(DISTINCT r.equipment) AS equipment_types FROM routes r GROUP BY r.source_airport, r.destination_airport HAVING frequency > 3 ORDER BY direct_airlines DESC, equipment_types DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT a.country, COUNT(*) AS airports, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.iata IS NULL AND a.icao IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS no_iata_has_icao, ROUND(AVG(a.latitude - a.longitude), 2) AS lat_lon_diff FROM airports a GROUP BY a.country HAVING airports > 3 ORDER BY no_iata_has_icao DESC, lat_lon_diff DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT al.country, COUNT(DISTINCT al.airline_id) AS airlines, COUNT(DISTINCT r.equipment) AS aircraft_types, SUM(CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 AND r.codeshare = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS direct_codeshare_routes FROM airlines al JOIN routes r ON al.airline_id = r.airline_id GROUP BY al.country HAVING airlines > 1 ORDER BY direct_codeshare_routes DESC, aircraft_types DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT a.city, COUNT(DISTINCT r.destination_airport_id) AS destinations, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a2.altitude > 1000 THEN r.destination_airport_id END) AS high_altitude_dests, ROUND(AVG(r.stops), 2) AS avg_stops FROM airports a JOIN routes r ON a.airport_id = r.source_airport_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id GROUP BY a.city HAVING destinations > 5 ORDER BY high_altitude_dests DESC, avg_stops ASC LIMIT 7

SELECT r.equipment, COUNT(*) AS routes, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 THEN r.airline_id END) AS direct_airlines, COUNT(DISTINCT a.country) AS source_countries FROM routes r JOIN airports a ON r.source_airport_id = a.airport_id GROUP BY r.equipment HAVING routes > 8 ORDER BY direct_airlines DESC, source_countries DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT a.country, COUNT(*) AS airports, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.type = 'large_airport' THEN 1 END) AS large_airports, ROUND(AVG(a.longitude - a.latitude), 2) AS lon_lat_diff FROM airports a GROUP BY a.country HAVING airports > 3 ORDER BY large_airports DESC, lon_lat_diff DESC LIMIT 7

SELECT r.source_airport, COUNT(DISTINCT r.destination_airport_id) AS destinations, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 AND r.codeshare = 'N' THEN r.airline_id END) AS direct_non_codeshare_airlines, MIN(a.altitude) AS min_altitude FROM routes r JOIN airports a ON r.source_airport_id = a.airport_id GROUP BY r.source_airport HAVING destinations > 4 ORDER BY direct_non_codeshare_airlines DESC, min_altitude ASC LIMIT 5

SELECT al.country, COUNT(DISTINCT al.airline_id) AS airlines, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN al.iata IS NULL THEN al.airline_id END) AS no_iata_airlines, COUNT(DISTINCT r.equipment) AS unique_aircraft FROM airlines al LEFT JOIN routes r ON al.airline_id = r.airline_id GROUP BY al.country HAVING airlines > 2 ORDER BY no_iata_airlines DESC, unique_aircraft DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT r.airline, COUNT(*) AS routes, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a1.country <> a2.country THEN r.destination_airport_id END) AS international_destinations, ROUND(AVG(a2.altitude), 1) AS avg_dest_alt FROM routes r JOIN airports a1 ON r.source_airport_id = a1.airport_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id GROUP BY r.airline HAVING routes > 10 ORDER BY international_destinations DESC, avg_dest_alt DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT a.city, COUNT(DISTINCT a.airport_id) AS airports, COUNT(DISTINCT r.equipment) AS aircraft_types, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops > 0 THEN r.airline_id END) AS indirect_airlines FROM airports a LEFT JOIN routes r ON a.airport_id = r.source_airport_id GROUP BY a.city HAVING airports > 1 ORDER BY aircraft_types DESC, indirect_airlines DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT r.equipment, COUNT(*) AS route_count, COUNT(DISTINCT r.airline_id) AS airlines, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 AND r.codeshare = 'N' THEN r.destination_airport_id END) AS direct_non_codeshare_dests FROM routes r GROUP BY r.equipment HAVING route_count > 8 ORDER BY airlines DESC, direct_non_codeshare_dests DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT al.country, COUNT(DISTINCT al.airline_id) AS airlines, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN al.active = 'Y' AND al.icao IS NOT NULL THEN al.airline_id END) AS active_icao_airlines, ROUND(AVG(r.stops), 2) AS avg_stops FROM airlines al JOIN routes r ON al.airline_id = r.airline_id GROUP BY al.country HAVING airlines > 2 ORDER BY active_icao_airlines DESC, avg_stops ASC LIMIT 6

SELECT r.source_airport, COUNT(DISTINCT r.destination_airport_id) AS destinations, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 AND a2.altitude < 100 THEN r.destination_airport_id END) AS coastal_direct_dests, MAX(a.longitude) AS easternmost_point FROM routes r JOIN airports a ON r.source_airport_id = a.airport_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id GROUP BY r.source_airport HAVING destinations > 4 ORDER BY coastal_direct_dests DESC, easternmost_point DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT al.name AS airline, COUNT(*) AS routes, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 AND a2.latitude < -40 THEN r.destination_airport_id END) AS southern_direct_dests, COUNT(DISTINCT r.equipment) AS aircraft_types FROM routes r JOIN airlines al ON r.airline_id = al.airline_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id WHERE al.active = 'Y' GROUP BY al.name HAVING routes > 12 ORDER BY southern_direct_dests DESC, aircraft_types DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT a.country, COUNT(*) AS airports, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.type = 'small_airport' AND a.altitude > 1000 THEN 1 END) AS high_altitude_small_airports, ROUND(AVG(a.latitude), 2) AS avg_lat FROM airports a GROUP BY a.country HAVING airports > 3 ORDER BY high_altitude_small_airports DESC, avg_lat DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT r.source_airport, r.destination_airport, COUNT(*) AS frequency, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 THEN r.equipment END) AS direct_equipment, MIN(a2.altitude) AS dest_min_alt FROM routes r JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id GROUP BY r.source_airport, r.destination_airport HAVING frequency > 2 ORDER BY direct_equipment DESC, dest_min_alt ASC LIMIT 8

SELECT al.country, COUNT(DISTINCT al.airline_id) AS airlines, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN al.iata IS NOT NULL AND al.active = 'Y' THEN al.airline_id END) AS active_iata_airlines, COUNT(DISTINCT r.source_airport_id) AS unique_departure_points FROM airlines al JOIN routes r ON al.airline_id = r.airline_id GROUP BY al.country HAVING airlines > 1 ORDER BY active_iata_airlines DESC, unique_departure_points DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT a.city, COUNT(DISTINCT a.airport_id) AS airports, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 THEN r.destination_airport_id END) AS direct_destinations, ROUND(AVG(a.altitude), 1) AS avg_alt FROM airports a LEFT JOIN routes r ON a.airport_id = r.source_airport_id WHERE a.country = 'Germany' GROUP BY a.city HAVING airports > 1 ORDER BY direct_destinations DESC, avg_alt DESC LIMIT 7

SELECT a.country, COUNT(*) AS airports, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.type = 'heliport' THEN 1 END) AS heliports, ROUND(AVG(a.latitude), 2) AS avg_lat FROM airports a GROUP BY a.country HAVING airports > 2 ORDER BY heliports DESC, avg_lat DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT r.source_airport, COUNT(DISTINCT r.destination_airport_id) AS destinations, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 AND a2.country = 'China' THEN r.destination_airport_id END) AS direct_china_dests, MAX(a.latitude) AS northernmost_point FROM routes r JOIN airports a ON r.source_airport_id = a.airport_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id GROUP BY r.source_airport HAVING destinations > 5 ORDER BY direct_china_dests DESC, northernmost_point DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT a.country, COUNT(DISTINCT a.airport_id) AS airports, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 2 THEN r.destination_airport_id END) AS two_stop_destinations, ROUND(AVG(a.altitude), 1) AS avg_alt FROM airports a LEFT JOIN routes r ON a.airport_id = r.source_airport_id GROUP BY a.country HAVING airports > 3 ORDER BY two_stop_destinations DESC, avg_alt DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT r.equipment, COUNT(*) AS routes, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 1 THEN r.airline_id END) AS one_stop_airlines, COUNT(DISTINCT a1.timezone) AS source_timezones FROM routes r JOIN airports a1 ON r.source_airport_id = a1.airport_id GROUP BY r.equipment HAVING routes > 7 ORDER BY one_stop_airlines DESC, source_timezones DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT al.country, COUNT(DISTINCT al.airline_id) AS airlines, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN al.callsign LIKE 'AIR%' THEN al.airline_id END) AS air_prefix_callsigns, SUM(CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 AND r.codeshare = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS direct_non_codeshare_routes FROM airlines al JOIN routes r ON al.airline_id = r.airline_id GROUP BY al.country HAVING airlines > 1 ORDER BY air_prefix_callsigns DESC, direct_non_codeshare_routes DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT r.source_airport, r.destination_airport, COUNT(*) AS frequency, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 AND r.codeshare = 'Y' THEN r.airline_id END) AS direct_codeshare_airlines, MAX(a1.altitude) AS source_max_alt FROM routes r JOIN airports a1 ON r.source_airport_id = a1.airport_id GROUP BY r.source_airport, r.destination_airport HAVING frequency > 2 ORDER BY direct_codeshare_airlines DESC, source_max_alt DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT al.name AS airline, COUNT(DISTINCT r.source_airport_id) AS hubs, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 AND a2.longitude < -100 THEN r.destination_airport_id END) AS western_hemisphere_direct_dests, ROUND(AVG(r.stops), 2) AS avg_stops FROM routes r JOIN airlines al ON r.airline_id = al.airline_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id WHERE al.active = 'Y' GROUP BY al.name HAVING hubs > 1 ORDER BY western_hemisphere_direct_dests DESC, avg_stops ASC LIMIT 6

SELECT a.country, COUNT(DISTINCT a.airport_id) AS airports, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.codeshare = 'Y' THEN r.destination_airport_id END) AS codeshare_destinations, ROUND(AVG(a.altitude), 1) AS avg_alt FROM airports a LEFT JOIN routes r ON a.airport_id = r.source_airport_id GROUP BY a.country HAVING airports > 2 ORDER BY codeshare_destinations DESC, avg_alt DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT r.equipment, COUNT(*) AS route_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.country = 'United States' THEN r.source_airport_id END) AS us_sources, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 THEN r.airline_id END) AS direct_airlines FROM routes r JOIN airports a ON r.source_airport_id = a.airport_id GROUP BY r.equipment HAVING route_count > 7 ORDER BY us_sources DESC, direct_airlines DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT al.country, COUNT(DISTINCT al.airline_id) AS airlines, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN al.active = 'N' AND al.iata IS NOT NULL THEN al.airline_id END) AS inactive_iata_airlines, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 2) AS direct_ratio FROM airlines al JOIN routes r ON al.airline_id = r.airline_id GROUP BY al.country HAVING airlines > 1 ORDER BY inactive_iata_airlines DESC, direct_ratio DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT a.city, COUNT(DISTINCT a.airport_id) AS airports, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 AND a2.timezone = a.timezone THEN r.destination_airport_id END) AS same_timezone_direct_dests FROM airports a JOIN routes r ON a.airport_id = r.source_airport_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id GROUP BY a.city HAVING airports > 1 ORDER BY same_timezone_direct_dests DESC, airports DESC LIMIT 7

SELECT r.airline, COUNT(*) AS routes, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a1.altitude > a2.altitude THEN r.destination_airport_id END) AS lower_altitude_dests, COUNT(DISTINCT r.equipment) AS equipment_types FROM routes r JOIN airports a1 ON r.source_airport_id = a1.airport_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id GROUP BY r.airline HAVING routes > 10 ORDER BY lower_altitude_dests DESC, equipment_types DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT r.source_airport, COUNT(DISTINCT r.destination_airport_id) AS destinations, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 AND a2.type = 'large_airport' THEN r.destination_airport_id END) AS direct_large_airport_dests, MIN(a.latitude) AS southernmost_point FROM routes r JOIN airports a ON r.source_airport_id = a.airport_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id GROUP BY r.source_airport HAVING destinations > 4 ORDER BY direct_large_airport_dests DESC, southernmost_point ASC LIMIT 5

SELECT a.country, COUNT(*) AS airports, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.iata IS NOT NULL AND a.altitude < 50 THEN 1 END) AS coastal_iata_airports, ROUND(AVG(a.longitude - a.latitude), 2) AS lon_lat_diff FROM airports a GROUP BY a.country HAVING airports > 3 ORDER BY coastal_iata_airports DESC, lon_lat_diff DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT r.equipment, COUNT(*) AS routes, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 AND a1.country <> a2.country THEN r.destination_airport_id END) AS international_direct_dests, COUNT(DISTINCT a1.timezone) AS source_timezones FROM routes r JOIN airports a1 ON r.source_airport_id = a1.airport_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id GROUP BY r.equipment HAVING routes > 8 ORDER BY international_direct_dests DESC, source_timezones DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT al.name AS airline, COUNT(*) AS routes, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a1.country = a2.country AND r.stops = 0 THEN r.destination_airport_id END) AS domestic_direct_dests, ROUND(AVG(a2.altitude), 1) AS avg_dest_alt FROM routes r JOIN airlines al ON r.airline_id = al.airline_id JOIN airports a1 ON r.source_airport_id = a1.airport_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id WHERE al.active = 'Y' GROUP BY al.name HAVING routes > 8 ORDER BY domestic_direct_dests DESC, avg_dest_alt DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT r.equipment, COUNT(*) AS routes, COUNT(DISTINCT r.airline_id) AS airlines, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.latitude > 0 THEN r.source_airport_id END) AS northern_hemisphere_sources FROM routes r JOIN airports a ON r.source_airport_id = a.airport_id GROUP BY r.equipment HAVING routes > 5 ORDER BY northern_hemisphere_sources DESC, airlines DESC LIMIT 7

SELECT a.city, COUNT(DISTINCT r.destination_airport_id) AS destinations, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 AND a2.country = 'United States' THEN r.destination_airport_id END) AS direct_us_destinations, ROUND(AVG(a.longitude), 2) AS avg_longitude FROM airports a JOIN routes r ON a.airport_id = r.source_airport_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id GROUP BY a.city HAVING destinations > 4 ORDER BY direct_us_destinations DESC, avg_longitude DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT al.country, COUNT(DISTINCT al.airline_id) AS airlines, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN al.icao LIKE 'B%' THEN al.airline_id END) AS b_code_airlines, SUM(CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS direct_routes FROM airlines al JOIN routes r ON al.airline_id = r.airline_id GROUP BY al.country HAVING airlines > 2 ORDER BY b_code_airlines DESC, direct_routes DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT r.source_airport, COUNT(DISTINCT r.destination_airport_id) AS destinations, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 AND a2.altitude > 1500 THEN r.destination_airport_id END) AS direct_high_altitude_dests, MAX(a.latitude) AS max_latitude FROM routes r JOIN airports a ON r.source_airport_id = a.airport_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id GROUP BY r.source_airport HAVING destinations > 5 ORDER BY direct_high_altitude_dests DESC, max_latitude DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT al.name AS airline, COUNT(DISTINCT r.equipment) AS aircraft_types, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 AND a2.latitude < -20 THEN r.destination_airport_id END) AS southern_direct_destinations, ROUND(AVG(r.stops), 2) AS avg_stops FROM routes r JOIN airlines al ON r.airline_id = al.airline_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id WHERE al.active = 'Y' GROUP BY al.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 ORDER BY southern_direct_destinations DESC, aircraft_types DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT r.source_airport, r.destination_airport, COUNT(*) AS frequency, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 THEN r.equipment END) AS direct_equipment_types, MIN(a2.altitude) AS min_dest_altitude FROM routes r JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id GROUP BY r.source_airport, r.destination_airport HAVING frequency > 2 ORDER BY direct_equipment_types DESC, min_dest_altitude ASC LIMIT 8

SELECT a.country, COUNT(*) AS airports, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.type = 'closed' THEN 1 END) AS closed_airports, ROUND(AVG(a.latitude), 2) AS avg_latitude FROM airports a GROUP BY a.country HAVING airports > 2 ORDER BY closed_airports DESC, avg_latitude DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT r.source_airport, COUNT(*) AS routes, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 THEN r.destination_airport_id END) AS direct_destinations, COUNT(DISTINCT al.country) AS destination_countries FROM routes r JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id JOIN airlines al ON r.airline_id = al.airline_id GROUP BY r.source_airport HAVING routes > 8 ORDER BY direct_destinations DESC, destination_countries DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT al.country, COUNT(DISTINCT al.airline_id) AS airlines, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN al.callsign IS NOT NULL THEN al.airline_id END) AS has_callsign, ROUND(AVG(a.altitude), 1) AS avg_airport_altitude FROM airlines al JOIN routes r ON al.airline_id = r.airline_id JOIN airports a ON r.source_airport_id = a.airport_id GROUP BY al.country HAVING airlines > 2 ORDER BY has_callsign DESC, avg_airport_altitude DESC LIMIT 7

SELECT a.city, COUNT(DISTINCT r.airline_id) AS airlines, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 AND r.codeshare = 'Y' THEN r.destination_airport_id END) AS direct_codeshare_dests, ROUND(AVG(a.longitude), 2) AS avg_longitude FROM airports a JOIN routes r ON a.airport_id = r.source_airport_id GROUP BY a.city HAVING airlines > 3 ORDER BY direct_codeshare_dests DESC, avg_longitude DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT al.name AS airline, COUNT(DISTINCT r.source_airport_id) AS departure_airports, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 THEN r.equipment END) AS direct_equipment, ROUND(AVG(a.latitude), 2) AS avg_departure_lat FROM routes r JOIN airlines al ON r.airline_id = al.airline_id JOIN airports a ON r.source_airport_id = a.airport_id WHERE al.active = 'Y' GROUP BY al.name HAVING departure_airports > 2 ORDER BY direct_equipment DESC, avg_departure_lat DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT a.country, COUNT(*) AS airports, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.type = 'large_airport' AND a.iata IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS large_iata_airports, ROUND(AVG(a.latitude), 2) AS avg_latitude FROM airports a GROUP BY a.country HAVING airports > 4 ORDER BY large_iata_airports DESC, avg_latitude DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT r.airline, COUNT(*) AS routes, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a2.altitude < 0 THEN r.destination_airport_id END) AS below_sea_level_dests, COUNT(DISTINCT r.equipment) AS equipment_types FROM routes r JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id GROUP BY r.airline HAVING routes > 10 ORDER BY below_sea_level_dests DESC, equipment_types DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT r.source_airport, r.destination_airport, COUNT(*) AS frequency, COUNT(DISTINCT al.country) AS airline_countries, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 1 THEN r.equipment END) AS one_stop_equipment FROM routes r JOIN airlines al ON r.airline_id = al.airline_id GROUP BY r.source_airport, r.destination_airport HAVING frequency > 3 ORDER BY airline_countries DESC, one_stop_equipment DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT al.country, COUNT(DISTINCT al.airline_id) AS airlines, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN al.active = 'Y' AND al.iata IS NULL THEN al.airline_id END) AS active_no_iata, ROUND(AVG(r.stops), 2) AS avg_stops FROM airlines al JOIN routes r ON al.airline_id = r.airline_id GROUP BY al.country HAVING airlines > 1 ORDER BY active_no_iata DESC, avg_stops ASC LIMIT 6

SELECT a.country, COUNT(*) AS airports, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.type = 'seaplane_base' THEN 1 END) AS seaplane_bases, ROUND(AVG(a.longitude), 2) AS avg_lon FROM airports a GROUP BY a.country HAVING airports > 2 ORDER BY seaplane_bases DESC, avg_lon DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT r.equipment, COUNT(*) AS routes, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 AND a1.altitude > 3000 THEN r.source_airport_id END) AS high_altitude_direct_sources, COUNT(DISTINCT a2.country) AS dest_countries FROM routes r JOIN airports a1 ON r.source_airport_id = a1.airport_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id GROUP BY r.equipment HAVING routes > 6 ORDER BY high_altitude_direct_sources DESC, dest_countries DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT al.country, COUNT(DISTINCT al.airline_id) AS airlines, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN al.icao LIKE 'C%' THEN al.airline_id END) AS c_code_airlines, SUM(CASE WHEN r.stops = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS two_stop_routes FROM airlines al JOIN routes r ON al.airline_id = r.airline_id GROUP BY al.country HAVING airlines > 1 ORDER BY c_code_airlines DESC, two_stop_routes DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT r.source_airport, COUNT(DISTINCT r.destination_airport_id) AS destinations, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 AND a2.type = 'medium_airport' THEN r.destination_airport_id END) AS direct_medium_airport_dests, MAX(a.longitude) AS easternmost FROM routes r JOIN airports a ON r.source_airport_id = a.airport_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id GROUP BY r.source_airport HAVING destinations > 3 ORDER BY direct_medium_airport_dests DESC, easternmost DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT al.name AS airline, COUNT(DISTINCT r.source_airport_id) AS hubs, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 AND a2.latitude > 40 AND a2.latitude < 60 THEN r.destination_airport_id END) AS temperate_direct_dests, ROUND(AVG(a2.longitude), 2) AS avg_dest_lon FROM routes r JOIN airlines al ON r.airline_id = al.airline_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id WHERE al.active = 'Y' GROUP BY al.name HAVING hubs > 1 ORDER BY temperate_direct_dests DESC, avg_dest_lon DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT r.source_airport, r.destination_airport, COUNT(*) AS frequency, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 AND r.codeshare = 'N' THEN r.airline_id END) AS direct_non_codeshare_airlines, MAX(a1.altitude) AS source_max_alt FROM routes r JOIN airports a1 ON r.source_airport_id = a1.airport_id GROUP BY r.source_airport, r.destination_airport HAVING frequency > 2 ORDER BY direct_non_codeshare_airlines DESC, source_max_alt DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT a.country, COUNT(*) AS airports, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.iata IS NOT NULL AND a.altitude > 2000 THEN 1 END) AS high_altitude_iata_airports, ROUND(AVG(a.latitude), 2) AS avg_lat FROM airports a GROUP BY a.country HAVING airports > 3 ORDER BY high_altitude_iata_airports DESC, avg_lat DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT a.country, COUNT(DISTINCT a.airport_id) AS airports, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 AND al.active = 'Y' THEN r.airline_id END) AS active_direct_airlines FROM airports a LEFT JOIN routes r ON a.airport_id = r.source_airport_id LEFT JOIN airlines al ON r.airline_id = al.airline_id GROUP BY a.country HAVING airports > 2 ORDER BY active_direct_airlines DESC, airports DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT al.name AS airline, COUNT(DISTINCT r.equipment) AS aircraft_types, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 AND a2.country = 'Japan' THEN r.destination_airport_id END) AS direct_japan_dests, ROUND(AVG(a1.latitude), 2) AS avg_departure_lat FROM routes r JOIN airlines al ON r.airline_id = al.airline_id JOIN airports a1 ON r.source_airport_id = a1.airport_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id WHERE al.active = 'Y' GROUP BY al.name HAVING aircraft_types > 3 ORDER BY direct_japan_dests DESC, avg_departure_lat DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT al.country, COUNT(DISTINCT al.airline_id) AS airlines, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN al.iata IS NOT NULL AND al.icao IS NOT NULL THEN al.airline_id END) AS full_code_airlines, SUM(CASE WHEN r.codeshare = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS codeshare_routes FROM airlines al JOIN routes r ON al.airline_id = r.airline_id GROUP BY al.country HAVING airlines > 1 ORDER BY full_code_airlines DESC, codeshare_routes DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT r.source_airport, COUNT(DISTINCT r.destination_airport_id) AS destinations, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 AND a2.type = 'small_airport' THEN r.destination_airport_id END) AS direct_small_airport_dests, MIN(a.altitude) AS min_altitude FROM routes r JOIN airports a ON r.source_airport_id = a.airport_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id GROUP BY r.source_airport HAVING destinations > 4 ORDER BY direct_small_airport_dests DESC, min_altitude ASC LIMIT 5

SELECT al.name AS airline, COUNT(*) AS routes, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 AND a2.longitude > 0 THEN r.destination_airport_id END) AS eastern_hemisphere_direct_dests, COUNT(DISTINCT a1.country) AS source_countries FROM routes r JOIN airlines al ON r.airline_id = al.airline_id JOIN airports a1 ON r.source_airport_id = a1.airport_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id WHERE al.active = 'Y' GROUP BY al.name HAVING routes > 8 ORDER BY eastern_hemisphere_direct_dests DESC, source_countries DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT r.source_airport, r.destination_airport, COUNT(*) AS frequency, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 THEN al.country END) AS direct_airline_countries, AVG(a2.latitude) AS avg_dest_lat FROM routes r JOIN airlines al ON r.airline_id = al.airline_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id GROUP BY r.source_airport, r.destination_airport HAVING frequency > 2 ORDER BY direct_airline_countries DESC, avg_dest_lat DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT a.country, COUNT(*) AS airports, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.type = 'heliport' AND a.altitude < 100 THEN 1 END) AS low_altitude_heliports, ROUND(AVG(a.latitude), 2) AS avg_latitude FROM airports a GROUP BY a.country HAVING airports > 2 ORDER BY low_altitude_heliports DESC, avg_latitude DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT al.country, COUNT(DISTINCT al.airline_id) AS airlines, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN al.active = 'Y' AND al.callsign LIKE '%AIR%' THEN al.airline_id END) AS air_callsign_airlines, ROUND(AVG(a.altitude), 1) AS avg_altitude FROM airlines al JOIN routes r ON al.airline_id = r.airline_id JOIN airports a ON r.source_airport_id = a.airport_id GROUP BY al.country HAVING airlines > 2 ORDER BY air_callsign_airlines DESC, avg_altitude DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT r.source_airport, COUNT(DISTINCT r.destination_airport_id) AS destinations, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 AND a2.type = 'large_airport' THEN r.destination_airport_id END) AS direct_large_dests, MIN(a.latitude) AS min_latitude FROM routes r JOIN airports a ON r.source_airport_id = a.airport_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id WHERE a.country = 'United States' GROUP BY r.source_airport HAVING destinations > 3 ORDER BY direct_large_dests DESC, min_latitude ASC LIMIT 5

SELECT r.equipment, COUNT(*) AS routes, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 AND a1.country = 'Germany' THEN r.source_airport_id END) AS german_direct_sources, COUNT(DISTINCT a2.country) AS dest_countries FROM routes r JOIN airports a1 ON r.source_airport_id = a1.airport_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id GROUP BY r.equipment HAVING routes > 5 ORDER BY german_direct_sources DESC, dest_countries DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT al.name AS airline, COUNT(DISTINCT r.source_airport_id) AS hubs, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 AND a2.altitude < 50 THEN r.destination_airport_id END) AS coastal_direct_dests, ROUND(AVG(r.stops), 2) AS avg_stops FROM routes r JOIN airlines al ON r.airline_id = al.airline_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id WHERE al.active = 'Y' GROUP BY al.name HAVING hubs > 1 ORDER BY coastal_direct_dests DESC, avg_stops ASC LIMIT 5

SELECT a.country, COUNT(*) AS airports, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.type = 'medium_airport' AND a.iata IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS medium_iata_airports, ROUND(AVG(a.latitude), 2) AS avg_lat FROM airports a GROUP BY a.country HAVING airports > 3 ORDER BY medium_iata_airports DESC, avg_lat DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT r.source_airport, r.destination_airport, COUNT(*) AS frequency, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 THEN r.airline_id END) AS direct_airlines, MAX(a2.altitude) AS max_dest_alt FROM routes r JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id GROUP BY r.source_airport, r.destination_airport HAVING frequency > 2 ORDER BY direct_airlines DESC, max_dest_alt DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT al.country, COUNT(DISTINCT al.airline_id) AS airlines, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN al.iata IS NULL AND al.active = 'Y' THEN al.airline_id END) AS active_no_iata, SUM(CASE WHEN r.codeshare = 'Y' AND r.stops = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS direct_codeshare_routes FROM airlines al JOIN routes r ON al.airline_id = r.airline_id GROUP BY al.country HAVING airlines > 2 ORDER BY active_no_iata DESC, direct_codeshare_routes DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT a.city, COUNT(*) AS airports, COUNT(DISTINCT r.destination_airport_id) AS destinations, ROUND(AVG(a.altitude), 1) AS avg_altitude FROM airports a JOIN routes r ON a.airport_id = r.source_airport_id WHERE a.country = 'France' GROUP BY a.city HAVING airports > 1 ORDER BY destinations DESC, avg_altitude ASC LIMIT 5

SELECT al.name AS airline, COUNT(*) AS routes, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a1.country <> a2.country AND r.stops = 0 THEN r.destination_airport_id END) AS international_direct_dests, COUNT(DISTINCT r.equipment) AS equipment_types FROM routes r JOIN airlines al ON r.airline_id = al.airline_id JOIN airports a1 ON r.source_airport_id = a1.airport_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id WHERE al.active = 'Y' GROUP BY al.name HAVING routes > 8 ORDER BY international_direct_dests DESC, equipment_types DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT r.equipment, COUNT(*) AS routes, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 THEN r.airline_id END) AS direct_airlines, COUNT(DISTINCT a1.country) AS source_countries FROM routes r JOIN airports a1 ON r.source_airport_id = a1.airport_id GROUP BY r.equipment HAVING routes > 10 ORDER BY direct_airlines DESC, source_countries DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT al.country, COUNT(DISTINCT al.airline_id) AS airlines, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN al.icao IS NOT NULL THEN al.airline_id END) AS icao_airlines, ROUND(AVG(a.latitude), 2) AS avg_source_lat FROM airlines al JOIN routes r ON al.airline_id = r.airline_id JOIN airports a ON r.source_airport_id = a.airport_id GROUP BY al.country HAVING airlines > 2 ORDER BY icao_airlines DESC, avg_source_lat DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT a.city, COUNT(DISTINCT r.destination_airport_id) AS destinations, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 1 AND a2.country = 'United Kingdom' THEN r.destination_airport_id END) AS uk_one_stop_dests, ROUND(AVG(a.latitude), 2) AS avg_lat FROM airports a JOIN routes r ON a.airport_id = r.source_airport_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id GROUP BY a.city HAVING destinations > 5 ORDER BY uk_one_stop_dests DESC, avg_lat DESC LIMIT 7

SELECT r.source_airport, COUNT(DISTINCT r.destination_airport_id) AS destinations, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.stops = 0 AND a2.altitude < 0 THEN r.destination_airport_id END) AS below_sea_level_dests, MAX(a.longitude) AS max_longitude FROM routes r JOIN airports a ON r.source_airport_id = a.airport_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id GROUP BY r.source_airport HAVING destinations > 4 ORDER BY below_sea_level_dests DESC, max_longitude DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT r.equipment, COUNT(*) AS routes, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a1.altitude > 1000 AND a2.altitude > 1000 THEN r.destination_airport_id END) AS high_altitude_dests, COUNT(DISTINCT a1.country) AS source_countries FROM routes r JOIN airports a1 ON r.source_airport_id = a1.airport_id JOIN airports a2 ON r.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id GROUP BY r.equipment HAVING routes > 8 ORDER BY high_altitude_dests DESC, source_countries DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT a.country, COUNT(*) AS airports, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.type = 'large_airport' THEN 1 END) AS large_airports, COUNT(DISTINCT r.airline_id) AS airlines FROM airports a LEFT JOIN routes r ON a.airport_id = r.source_airport_id GROUP BY a.country HAVING airports > 3 ORDER BY large_airports DESC, airlines DESC LIMIT 6
